name: Tamil
romanizationNotes: All Tamil content uses romanized text only (no Tamil script). Long vowels are doubled: aa, ii, uu, ee, oo. The retroflex 'zh' represents the unique Tamil sound (as in 'tamizh'). 'ng' represents the velar nasal. A simplified lowercase approach is used throughout — no capitals for retroflex consonants. Pronunciation guides use English-friendly approximations.
